授業概要
受講者の研究、研究計画、研究論文原稿に関して、発表と議論を行う。
In this course, students will learn how to conduct experimental research in perceptual psychology. The purpose of this course is to conduct students' own high-quality research that can be published in a journal paper.

・表現したい事柄を正しく分かりやすく表現できるように工夫できる能力を養う。
